lines.en: I trot across the savanna.
My steps are light and quick.
I walk low through the grass.
I change direction and circle around.
My walk is springy.
I pass a termite mound.
I head slowly your way.
My tail rides half up.
I walk along the savanna slope.
I avoid the tallest grass.
I slowly press my body down.
I stand in the grass, very still.
I watch the grass move far off.
My tail tip sways.
I rest on the grassy slope.
I lift my head and my nose works.
I settle down into a crouch.
I turn my ears slowly.
I wait for the wind to shift.
I press my body to the grass.
I stand by a termite mound.
I am alert, not afraid.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，又闭上嘴。
lines.en: I yawn and close my mouth.
I count the sounds in the grass.
The wind lifts my fur.
I turn and show my spots.
I raise my head and study you.
I am judging how fast you are.
You step back and I relax.
My nose twitches twice.

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到别的动物。
lines.en: I smell other animals on you.
I edge sideways a little.
I crouch and look at you.
I do not like sudden movements.

lines.zh: 你的手指一动，我就后缩
lines.en: When your fingers move, I flinch back.
I blink slowly.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边挪了一小步。
lines.en: I shift a small step your way.
I watch you, intent.
I lower myself, ears on you.
I do not mean to come closer.
I dart away.
I flinch inward.
I give a short yelp.
I retreat three or four blocks.
I suck in air and brace.

lines.zh: 我的腿有点发抖，不是累。
lines.en: My legs tremble, and not from tiredness.
I stare, ears back.
I step back and hold.
I edge back two more steps.
I stare at the meat, wary.

lines.zh: 我压低身子靠近那块肉
lines.en: I drop low and edge toward the meat.

lines.zh: 我往前挪一步又退半格。
lines.en: I step forward and retreat half.
I grab it and dart back two steps.
I come back and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 我吃得很快，吃两口就抬头。
lines.en: I eat fast, looking up between bites.

lines.zh: 它的味道让我放松了一点。
lines.en: The smell eases me a little.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看你离得多近。
lines.en: I look up to check how close you are.
I do not come near your hand.
I back off as soon as I finish.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我弹开好几格。
lines.en: You touch me and I spring back several blocks.
I am spun around in place.
I land and hold.
I retreat and check whether you follow.
Our impact rustles the grass.
I lower myself, ready to bolt.
I bolt far away, flattening the grass.
I slowly straighten up.
I am unhurt, only tense.

lines.zh: 两只猎豹在草原上绕圈。
lines.en: Two cheetahs circle on the savanna.
Our tails twine together.
We lie together on the slope.
I groom its neck.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴搭在我的尾巴上。
lines.en: Its tail rests on mine.
We watch the distant grass together.
Neither of us gets up.
Our heads rest together.
They trot one lap side by side.
I take the meat.
I carry it off two steps.
I bite once and set it down.
I check my surroundings.
I drag it behind a mound.
I chew it slowly.
I bat at it twice.
I carry it deep into the grass.
I press myself as low as possible.
I have locked on over there.
My ears press forward.
My whole body tenses.
I begin shifting inch by inch.
I fix on the shortest line.
I do not even blink.
I am ready to run.
I follow low through the grass.
It moves, and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我一直保持在它的下风。
lines.en: I stay downwind of it.
I keep out of the tall grass.

lines.zh: 草原上，我跑起来只剩一道线。
lines.en: On the savanna I'm just a streak.

lines.zh: 我能跑很久，也能等很久。
lines.en: I can run long, and wait longer.
It looks back and I crouch.
I shorten the distance bit by bit.
Only a few bounds away.
No rush; I will tire it first.
I pounce and pin it.
My claws dig into its back.
I ram and roll it over.
I miss the bite.
After the miss I pounce again at once.
I land and pounce again.
Its tail lashes me.
I hold it down.
My teeth sink deep.

lines.zh: 草原上多了一只瘦长的影子。
lines.en: A lean shadow appears on the savanna.
I begin trotting this area.

lines.zh: 一只斑点很清楚的身影出现了。
lines.en: A spotted shape appears.

lines.zh: 我从白蚁丘后面走出来。
lines.en: I step from behind a termite mound.
The wind parts the grass and shows me.
I crouch on the slope and watch.
My tail shows first.
I begin walking the grass line.
I come out of the grass, head low.

lines.zh: 我停在离你十几格的地方。
lines.en: I stop a dozen blocks away.

lines.zh: 火让我慌了，我一路跑开。
lines.en: Fire panics me and I run.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，落在草里。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope into the grass.

lines.zh: 水让我跑不动，我扑腾着。
lines.en: Water stops my running; I thrash.
The blast sends me bolting.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的腿定住了。
lines.en: That force pins my legs.
One thunderclap flattens me.

lines.zh: 下面的草原没了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The savanna is gone; I fall.
